description:
You've entered a kitchen. I guess you better just go and list everything you see here.

Were you looking for a fridge? Because look over there, it's a fridge. You can make out a closed oven. You scan the room, seeing a table. The table is massive. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a stove. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of garbage.
